svg.title: open-compute target single-node multi-tenant Workers platform architecture
svg.desc: Target Day 1 architecture for one open-compute deployment. Clients, developer tooling, tenant egress, and operator-authorized host services sit on the left. The central deployment unit contains the ocd Rust authority, a verified pinned open-compute workerd fork, and a subordinate supervised-execution group for document jobs plus planned Browser Run and embedded Container runtimes. Local SQLite and filesystem authority and the selected Local or S3 object-byte authority sit on the right. Dashed modules are planned final components. Connectors render behind blocks and remain in dedicated gutters.
svg.text: One release unit · one ocd authority · pinned workerd fork · final planned runtimes shown with dashed borders
SINGLE DEPLOYMENT UNIT · ONE CONFIG · ONE AUTHORITY LIFECYCLE
ocd is the only public listener
ocd — Rust host and data authority
sole public/control listener · data-dir owner · deployment / resource / scheduler / runtime lifecycle
AI Search · Browser sessions · Container rollouts
locked fork revision + upstream base · compiled Cap'n Proto · isolated execution
CPU · memory · startup · subrequests · connection admission · request outcomes
TENANT TRUST BOUNDARY · no data paths · no host credentials · no control API · no internal token or sibling identity
Browser sessions · Container images / apps / rollouts
KV / D1 / Vectorize / AI Search SQLite
Artifacts bare Git · quarantine · master key
WAL · lock · verified runtime caches · profiles
tenants receive no object paths or credentials
Solid modules are current; dashed modules are the documented target state.
Cloudflare API/config + the formally pinned open-compute workerd fork define compatibility · the production release remains one ocd executable
